pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Bubba G sittin' pretty at the top like he's Jardin' Arsenal, but Ghost Pepper's bringin' the heat to test them French fancies.** Gunner's been ridin' high on France's coattails, actin' like he discovered the secret sauce when really he's just openin' the ketchup packet, but France is solid so far. Meanwhile, Devin's bankin' on Spain like it's 2010 all over again — he must've seen another tiki-taka highlight reel and forgot Xavi ain't walkin' through that door. Spain ain't been puttin' on no masterclasses lately, but Ghost Pepper's still got 'em to his name and they could pull off a Texas-sized surprise in a world-class showdown in Arlington. I'm callin' it: Bubba G's gravy train is leavin' the station, and Ghost Pepper's gonna shake things up good. Mark my words, y'all — Spain's turnin' cowboy and lassoin' 'em up, 3-1.
